items.claim: 年度股東會議程列出3項公司議案外加1項股東提案。
items.quote: Today's vote is on 3 company proposals, including director
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 第一項公司議案是選舉董事提名人。
items.quote: the vote to elect director nominees
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 議程之一是針對高管薪酬的諮詢性投票。
items.quote: an advisory vote on named executive officer compensation
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 議程之一是批准安永(Ernst & Young)續任2026年度獨立會計師事務所。
items.quote: vote to ratify appointment of Ernst & Young
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 股東提案4由John Chevedden提出,訴求股東可用書面同意方式行使權利。
items.quote: shareholder right to act by written consent sponsored by
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 提案代表指出同類提案在2021年股東會曾獲78%高支持度。
items.quote: won an outstanding 78% Texas Instruments' shareholder
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 依現行規定,召開股東特別會議需取得25%流通股份支持。
items.quote: Texas Instruments requires the backing of 25% of all shares
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 提案代表主張25%門檻過高,並援引100多家公司作為佐證。
items.quote: the 25% figure is too high is that more than 100
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 提案代表稱這100多家公司沒有一家能舉出25%門檻下特別會議實際召開的案例。
items.quote: Not one of these 100 companies has ever cited even one
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 提案代表指控包括TI在內的公司偏好25%門檻,因為知道特別會議實際上不會發生。
items.quote: Companies such as Texas Instruments,like the 25% figure
items.speaker: Unknown Attendee (Chevedden's representative)

items.claim: 主席宣布投票已截止,開放現場就選票議案提問。
items.quote: I will now open the floor to questions about the ballot
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 初步計票結果顯示全部公司議案皆通過。
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)

items.claim: 初步計票結果顯示股東提案(書面同意權)未通過。
items.quote: the stockholder proposal did not pass
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (Chairman)
